scope: Fresh anonymous public download, SHA-256/size/checksum/CRC verification and exact accepted-candidate and retained native-evidence binding. This audit did not execute Windows or create new scientific runs. All native execution claims refer to the successful accepted Windows CI run.
limits: Full setup validates installation/coexistence of all 32 packs and starter scientific truth; it does not rerun every optional pack scientific fixture.
Offline checks deny Python host socket operations; native subprocesses are not OS-firewalled.
Physical trackpad, broad high-DPI/multi-monitor deployment and institutional proxies are not validated by these hosted Windows gates.
Only the published 0.10.0 baseline has an updater in this release.
Historical test-trust and failed validator evidence remains historical; it does not supply production acceptance.
Creation-time build provenance retains its original pending-validation statement; later RELEASE-VALIDATION.json and bound successful native reports record final acceptance.

The original 76 MB candidate artifact container was not redownloaded by this audit; its seven original member files were independently acquired through bounded transfers and are now byte-equal to the public downloads.
